text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, while walking inside the school 
building—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"Prettiest Dream," a brand-new sensation 
in black tea, huh... I wonder what kind of 
tea it is?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Still, to go all the way to a place like 
this just to taste it—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: T-Trainer?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: It's really nothing, okay...?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: After school that day—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...Should we check it out? No, going into 
such a cute cafe is...
choice_data_list: If you want to go, let's go!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: "Wah!? ...You again!?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Y-You heard that...!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I-It's not like that, I was just a little 
curious...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
It's not that I really want to go, I was 
just a little curious, that's all...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I just saw in a magazine that the black 
tea here is delicious... That's... that's 
all it is...!
choice_data_list: Then let's go check it out!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I just saw in a magazine that the black 
tea here is delicious... That's... that's 
all it is...!
choice_data_list: Then let's go check it out!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Huh? Wait, hold on—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I-I actually came...

text_block_list.name: Cute Clerk
text_block_list.text: Welcome~♪ What can I get for you-kyun?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Kyu, kyun!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Um... I'd like this "Prettiest Dream."

text_block_list.name: Cute Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Customer, you have an eye for 
quality-kyun♪ This is our shop's 
limited-edition cute tea-kyun!

text_block_list.name: Cute Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Understood~♪ Please wait just a 
moment-kyun!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... I really do stick out like a sore 
thumb, don't I...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
It is...! I'm just not the type of 
character who does "cute" or 
"heart-throbbing" stuff.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"You don't have to force yourself to be 
nice...! I know better than anyone that it 
doesn't suit me."

text_block_list.name: Cute Clerk
text_block_list.text:
"Prettiest Dream," right here for 
you-kyun♪

text_block_list.name: Cute Clerk
text_block_list.text:
"Prettiest Dream," right here for 
you-kyun♪

text_block_list.name: Cute Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Alright, repeat after me and cast the 
spell to make the black tea 
delicious-kyun!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Huh!?

text_block_list.name: Cute Clerk
text_block_list.text:
"It's the classic rule of 'Prettiest 
Dream', kyun! Now, make a heart with both 
hands—"

text_block_list.name: Cute Clerk
text_block_list.text:
"Kyun-kyun-dokyun♪ Tea, oh tea, become 
even more delicious~♪"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: T-Trainer?!

text_block_list.name: Cute Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Mhm-mhm, you were so cute, mister♪ Ma'am 
next to him, you're up next!

text_block_list.name: Cute Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Mhm-mhm, you were so cute, miss♪ Ma'am 
next to her, you're up next!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: N-No way...! I couldn't possibly—
choice_data_list:
It's all for the sake of discovering 
delicious black tea!

Why not just put it in your own words, 
Dober?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Guh...! True, that's why we came all the 
way here, but...

text_block_list.name: Cute Clerk
text_block_list.text: Go, go! You can do it, big sis♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
A-All right, I'll do it...! But, Trainer, 
cover your ears! Close your eyes, too!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Inhaaaale...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"...Kyun-kyun dokyun♪ Become even more 
delicious, dear tea~♪"

text_block_list.name: Cute Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Oh, how magical~♪ Big Sis's magic has made 
the black tea super tasty-kyun♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Jeez... ...I can't even taste it at all 
like this.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
My only saving grace is probably that you 
didn't hear my incantation...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
......You didn't hear the spell, right? 
You really, really didn't hear it, did 
you??

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even with my ears covered, I could still 
faintly hear Mejiro Dober's incantation... 
but I decided to keep that fact to myself.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even with my ears covered, I could still 
faintly hear Mejiro Dober's incantation... 
but I decided to keep that fact to myself.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: In my own way...?

text_block_list.name: Cute Clerk
text_block_list.text:
"That's right~♪ As long as it's made with 
love, it'll surely turn out yummy-kyun!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: W-Well, then...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: P-Please turn out delicious... please...!

text_block_list.name: Cute Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Kyaa~âª Big sis's original magic is so 
kyute-kyun! Even the black tea is 
thrilled-kyun!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I-It is NOT cute!!
choice_data_list:
And there we have a delicious cup of black 
tea.

And there we have a delicious cup of black 
tea.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: That's—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, it's delicious... Could it really 
be...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She liked the taste and bought some tea 
leaves on the way home—though she wouldn't 
say whether she chanted the incantation 
when drinking it alone.
